description: This file defines the SpContainer class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing a shape container with properties such as shape type, position, offsets, and hierarchy within shape groups.

classes.name: SpContainer
classes.description: Represents a shape container with properties for shape identification, positioning, and grouping in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent shape group container.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent shape group container.

methods.name: setSpgr
methods.description: Sets whether this shape is a group shape.

methods.name: getSpgr
methods.description: Returns whether this shape is a group shape.

methods.name: setSpType
methods.description: Sets the shape type.

methods.name: getSpType
methods.description: Gets the shape type.

methods.name: setSpFlag
methods.description: Sets the shape flag.

methods.name: getSpFlag
methods.description: Gets the shape flag.

methods.name: setSpId
methods.description: Sets the shape index.

methods.name: getSpId
methods.description: Gets the shape index.

methods.name: setOPT
methods.description: Sets an option for the shape container.

methods.name: getOPT
methods.description: Gets an option value for the shape container.

methods.name: getOPTCollection
methods.description: Returns the collection of options.

methods.name: setStartCoordinates
methods.description: Sets the cell coordinates of the upper-left corner of the shape.

methods.name: getStartCoordinates
methods.description: Gets the cell coordinates of the upper-left corner.

methods.name: setStartOffsetX
methods.description: Sets the horizontal offset of the upper-left corner.

methods.name: getStartOffsetX
methods.description: Gets the horizontal offset of the upper-left corner.

methods.name: setStartOffsetY
methods.description: Sets the vertical offset of the upper-left corner.

methods.name: getStartOffsetY
methods.description: Gets the vertical offset of the upper-left corner.

methods.name: setEndCoordinates
methods.description: Sets the bottom-right cell coordinates of the shape.

methods.name: getEndCoordinates
methods.description: Gets the bottom-right cell coordinates.

methods.name: setEndOffsetX
methods.description: Sets the horizontal offset of the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: getEndOffsetX
methods.description: Gets the horizontal offset of the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: setEndOffsetY
methods.description: Sets the vertical offset of the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: getEndOffsetY
methods.description: Gets the vertical offset of the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: getNestingLevel
methods.description: Returns the nesting level of the shape container within shape groups.
